title: Kagamine Rin — Share Your Memories〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, we should get going!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks for telling us all about the talk you had with your label☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're super welcome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, see you later.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They're so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They really are.
And they're at the point of putting a marketing strategy together...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've had this realization a few times already, but... They truly have gone pro.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, there's something very moving about it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, Mr. Shindo really threw them a tough question. What is their music gonna be about?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That is a tough one...
Shiho and Honami seemed rather uncertain...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The four of them came this far driven by the desire to move people's hearts through their performances.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm sure they each have their own hopes as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki have already given their answers. But I'm sure Shiho and Honami also will in time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, they've already thought through so many tough questions on the way to where they are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right...
I'm also sure that they'll find the answers they're looking for.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too. So, we just gotta keep believing in them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What's wrong, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry for causing you two so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll try giving it some thought when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...
It may take me some time, but I promise to come up with a satisfactory answer for when we next meet with Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I believe in them.
I really do. But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I can't help but wonder if I can do anything to help them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Help them?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. Like you guys said, finding the answers they're looking for isn't gonna be easy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But if they overthink things, they might stress themselves out...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I wanna know if there's anything I can do to help, even if it's just talking with them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I get what you're saying, Rin...
If talking about it will help, then I wanna bounce ideas off them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But most people need time to themselves when thinking about these sorts of questions, no?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I know!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...! But I'm getting so antsy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't wanna not help when there actually could be something I can do for them...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, then...
Why don't we go take a peek at how they're doing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A quick look should be fine as long as we don't interrupt.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm also curious to see how they're doing, so I might go give Honami a visit...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, Rin, you go see Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
...! Okay, I'll do that!
You can leave Shih to me!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I do understand how Rin feels.
We can believe all we want, but it's perfectly normal to feel some degree of anxiety.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah... If they are having trouble, please help them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! Hear that, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup!
